claims.text: Named Entity Recognition (NER) in the biomedical domain involves recognizing entities such as proteins, genes, diseases, treatments, and drugs.
NER systems in the biomedical field utilize various techniques, including machine learning and deep learning, to enhance performance.
Biomedical Information Extraction, which includes NER, applies state-of-the-art Natural Language Processing techniques to extract relevant information from text.
